{{Dialogue|The sergeant|General Skywalker, we've established contact with Rodia.|Skywalker|Rex, keep up the bombardment. I'll be back soon.|Rex|Yes, sir.|attr=The clone sergeant, General Anakin Skywalker, and Clone Captain Rex|src=<ref name="Transfer" />}}
This '''clone trooper''' was a [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he served under [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] in a [[Battle of unidentified planet (Skywalker and Tano)|battle]] against enemy [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] on a [[Unidentified planet (Skywalker and Tano)|planet]] and managed to establish contact with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], who had recently [[Mission to Rodia/Legends|captured]] [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|What happened, sergeant? ''Get her back.''"<br />"I can't sir. Too much interference from enemy artillery|Skywalker asks the sergeant to re-establish contact with [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]|<ref name="Transfer" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] held the rank of [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]]<ref name="Transfer" /> in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]],<ref name="Databank" /> and in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TCWdates|109}} ''[[The Clone Wars: Transfer]]'' takes place immediately prior to "Cloak of Darkness," placing it in 22 BBY as well.</ref> he participated in a [[Battle of unidentified planet (Skywalker and Tano)|battle]] on a [[Unidentified planet (Skywalker and Tano)|planet]]. At that battle, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces&mdash;under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]; his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]; and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]]&mdash;employed [[AV-7 Antivehicle Cannon/Legends|AV-7 Antivehicle Cannons]] against enemy [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]].<ref name="Transfer" />

[[File:Get_her_back.png|thumb|left|250px|Anakin Skywalker loses contact with Padmé Amidala.]]
After the Republic [[Troop/Legends|troops]] received news of a [[Mission to Rodia/Legends|coup]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], the [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] was able to establish contact with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] on the planet. Conversing with Amidala through a [[Hologram/Legends|hololink]], Skywalker discovered that she had captured [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], who was to be transferred to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to stand trial for war crimes.<ref name="Transfer" />

Suddenly, the transmission was interrupted, and Skywalker asked the sergeant to reestablish the contact. The [[Cloning/Legends|clone]], however, could not do so because of interference from enemy artillery. Worried for Amidala's safety, Skywalker then sent Tano to help oversee the transfer of Gunray.<ref name="Transfer" />

==Personality and traits==
Like all clone troopers, the sergeant had the height of 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="Databank" />

==Behind the scenes==
The clone sergeant appeared in ''[[The Clone Wars: Transfer]]'', an [[Star Wars comic books|issue]] of the weekly [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''The Clone Wars'' web comic series]] written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]], illustrated by [[Katie Cook]],<ref name="Transfer" /> and released on [[December 4]], [[2008]].<ref name="The Clone Wars archives-ninth page">{{SWArchive|url=archives/index.html?c=d6de5d83-4da5-48ab-bf34-75cd3af8fbef&k=&page=7|text=''The Clone Wars'' archives-seventh page}}</ref>
